summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Truejodi Matrimony Phase-2. Ran 15 pytest cases covering auth, profile update, completion %, photo CRUD (with 3-photo cap + primary promotion), recommendations, search filters, privacy hiding, block/unblock, and account deletion — all 15 PASS. Playwright UI test verified login redirect to /dashboard, all 9 sidebar tabs, save-profile with toast, recommendations badges (6), search page match-score badges (10), and apply filters flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~880 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, users, photos, search) for maintainability.
photos endpoint stores unbounded byte-count in-memory before size check — for larger MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE consider streaming/chunked read.
get_current_user does synchronous jwt.decode inside async handler; fine at current scale but note for high-throughput scenarios.
REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL currently set to http://localhost:8001 (fine for container-internal preview, will break if opened via external ingress URL — verify preview flow).
seed_data_creation: Uses already-seeded users (test user + 8 sample candidates). Test creates and deletes throwaway TEST_delete_* accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 15 tests across TestAuth/TestProfile/TestPhotos/TestRecommendations/TestSearch/TestPrivacy/TestBlocking/TestDeleteAccount. Bearer token flow (POST /api/auth/login → access_token → Authorization header) is source of truth. Object storage worked in this environment (photos uploaded successfully). Frontend data-testids match spec (dashboard-page, tab-*, save-profile-btn, dashboard-toast, recommended-section, rec-score-*, match-score-*, search-apply-filters-btn).
